extraction.Name: Samuel Lessert, Junior
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: he did not want this patent in fee, as he did not want to pay taxes; that he was told that, if he did not accept it, and keep his taxes up, it would be taxed just the same, and later sold for taxes, so he accepted the patent
extraction.Buyer: H. B. Cherry, of Martin, South Dakota, for the sum of $2500.00 cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: farming, which is his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; good health; has a wife and one child to support; wife and child have only fair health; did not sell his place for any debts incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee; considers he received a fair price for his allotment, but nothing more; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; land described as SE, Sec. 19, T.37N., R.39W., of the 6th P.M., in South Dakota; document reference numbers 2244 20/4
